The '''880 Palisade shield generator''' was a model of [[Reinforced shield generator]] made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and sold for 3800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The generator was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
